item.title: Croatian fishermen feel the strain after Iran war ramps up fuel prices
item.summary: Croatian fishermen are facing tough times as rising fuel prices, driven by the war in Iran, impact the industry

item.title: Russian strikes on Odesa kill 2 ahead of Orthodox Easter ceasefire
item.summary: Russian drone strikes killed at least two people and wounded two others in the Ukrainian city of Odesa overnight Saturday, hitting a residential area

item.title: Myanmar military chief who led 2021 army takeover takes presidency after criticized election
item.summary: Min Aung Hlaing, the army chief who ousted Aung San Suu Kyi's civilian government five years ago, has been sworn in as Myanmar's president

item.title: Citizen 'Frog Patrol' helps amphibians survive a dangerous road journey in Poland
item.summary: Hundreds of volunteers have joined a "Frog Patrol" initiative in a forest near the Polish capital of Warsaw to help amphibians survive road crossings during their spring mating rituals

item.title: Former Russian deputy defense minister is sentenced to 19 years for corruption
item.summary: A Russian military court sentenced former Deputy Defense Minister Pavel Popov to 19 years in prison Friday for embezzling funds from Patriot Park, a Moscow military theme park showcasing Soviet and Russian weaponry

item.title: South Korean minister vows to expand legal remedies for adoptees and other rights victims
item.summary: South Korean Justice Minister Jung Sung-ho vowed to expand access to judicial remedies for victims of state-led abuses, including foreign adoptees whose adoptions were marred by widespread fraud under previous military governments

item.title: Hungary's election could end Orbán's journey from liberal firebrand to far-right leader
item.summary: Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán faces a potential defeat in Sunday's elections that would end his long journey from post-Cold War liberal to far-right friend of Russian President Vladimir Putin

item.title: 1 killed, 27 injured as tourist bus plunges into a ravine in Spain’s Canary Islands
item.summary: A bus carrying tourists in Spain’s Canary Islands fell down a ravine, killing one person and injuring 27 others

item.title: Nigerian court convicts more than 300 in mass terrorism trial
item.summary: A court in Abuja, Nigeria, has convicted over 300 terrorism suspects in a four-day mass trial

item.title: Picture this: A raffle offers a Picasso for 100 euros to fund Alzheimer’s research
item.summary: A raffle in France offers the chance to win a Picasso portrait for a 100-euro ticket
